arxiv-1904-08791.title: Why do some probabilistic forecasts lack reliability?
arxiv-1904-08791.creator: Yûki Kubo
arxiv-1904-08791.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate the reliability of the probabilistic binary forecast. We mathematically prove that a necessary, but not sufficient, condition for achieving a reliable probabilistic forecast is maximizing the Peirce skill score ( P ​ S ​ S PSS ) at the threshold probability of the climatological base rate.

arxiv-2101-08786.creator: P. Chote, B. T. Gänsicke, J. McCormac, A. Aungwerojwit, D. Bayliss, M. R. Burleigh, S. L. Casewell, Ph. Eigmüller, S. Gill, M. R. Goad, J. J. Hermes, J. S. Jenkins, A. S. Mukadam, S. Poshyachinda, L. Raynard, D. E. Reichart, P. Szkody, O. Toloza, R. G. West, P. J. Wheatley
arxiv-2101-08786.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by P. Chote, B. T. Gänsicke, J. McCormac, A. Aungwerojwit, D. Bayliss, M. R. Burleigh, S. L. Casewell, Ph. Eigmüller, S. Gill, M. R. Goad, J. J. Hermes, J. S. Jenkins, A. S. Mukadam, S. Poshyachinda, L. Raynard, D. E. Reichart, P. Szkody, O. Toloza, R. G. West, P. J. Wheatley. Light curves of the accreting white dwarf pulsator GW Librae spanning a 7.5 month period in 2017 were obtained as part of the Next Generation Transit Survey .

arxiv-2103-08322.title: Position measurement of a dipolar scatterer via self-homodyne detection
arxiv-2103-08322.creator: G. Cerchiari, L. Dania, D. S. Bykov, R. Blatt, T. Northup
arxiv-2103-08322.description: Abstract We describe a technique to measure the position of a dipolar scatterer based on self-homodyne detection of the scattered light. The method can theoretically reach the Heisenberg limit, at which information gained about the position is constrained only by the back-action of the scattered light.

arxiv-2105-07813.title: Tidal deformability of neutron stars with exotic particles within a density dependent relativistic mean field model in R-squared gravity
arxiv-2105-07813.creator: K Nobleson, Tuhin Malik, Sarmistha Banik
arxiv-2105-07813.description: Abstract There is a growing interest in investigating modified theories of gravity, primarily, with the aim of explaining the universe’s accelerated expansion, which has been confirmed by several independent observations. Compact objects, like neutron stars, exhibit strong gravity effects and therefore are used to study modified gravity theories.

arxiv-2109-03417.title: Systematic trends of neutron skin thickness versus relative neutron excess
arxiv-2109-03417.creator: J. T. Zhang, X. L. Tu, P. Sarriguren, K. Yue, Q. Zeng, Z. Y. Sun, M. Wang, Y. H. Zhang, X. H. Zhou, Yu. A. Litvinov
arxiv-2109-03417.description: Abstract Available experimental neutron skin thicknesses of even-even stable Ca, Ni, Sn, Pb, and Cd isotopes are evaluated, and separate trends of neutron skin thickness versus relative neutron excess δ = ( N − Z ) / A \delta=(N-Z)/A are firstly observed for different isotopic chains.

arxiv-2203-01498.title: Existence and uniqueness of solutions to non-Abelian multiple vortex equations on graphs Thanks: 1 School of Mathematics and Statistics, Henan University, Kaifeng, Henan 475004, P. R. China. Thanks: Emails: yuanyhu@mail.ustc.edu.cn (Y. Hu).
arxiv-2203-01498.creator: Yuanyang Hu 1
arxiv-2203-01498.description: Abstract . Let G = ( V , E ) G=(V,E) be a connected finite graph. We study a system of non-Abelian multiple vortex equations on G G . We establish a necessary and sufficient condition for the existence and uniqueness of solutions to the non-Abelian multiple vortex equations. Mathematics Subject Classification (2010) 35A01, 35R02 .

arxiv-2207-10694.title: Collider Events on a Quantum Computer
arxiv-2207-10694.creator: Gösta Gustafson, Stefan Prestel, Michael Spannowsky, Simon Williams
arxiv-2207-10694.description: Abstract High-quality simulated data is crucial for particle physics discoveries. Therefore, parton shower algorithms are a major building block of the data synthesis in event generator programs. However, the core algorithms used to generate parton showers have barely changed since the 1980s.

arxiv-2207-11451.title: Optimization of the Shape of a Hydrokinetic Turbine’s Draft Tube and Hub Assembly Using Design-by-Morphing with Bayesian Optimization Journal: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
arxiv-2207-11451.creator: Haris Moazam Sheikh, Tess A. Callan, Kealan J. Hennessy, Philip S. Marcus
arxiv-2207-11451.description: Abstract Finding the optimal design of a hydrodynamic or aerodynamic surface is often impossible due to the expense of evaluating the cost functions (say, with computational fluid dynamics) needed to determine the performances of the flows that the surface controls.

arxiv-2309-01314.creator: Tim Menzies
arxiv-2309-01314.description: Abstract . To make models more understandable and correctable, I propose that the PROMISE community pivots to the problem of model review . Over the years, there have been many reports that very simple models can perform exceptionally well. Yet, where are the researchers asking “say, does that mean that we could make software analytics simpler and more comprehensible?

arxiv-2311-13189.title: From integrability to chaos: the quantum-classical correspondence in a triple well bosonic model
arxiv-2311-13189.creator: Erick R. Castro, Karin Wittmann W, Jorge Chávez-Carlos, Itzhak Roditi, Angela Foerster, Jorge G. Hirsch
arxiv-2311-13189.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate the semiclassical limit of a simple bosonic quantum many-body system exhibiting both integrable and chaotic behavior. A classical Hamiltonian is derived using coherent states. The transition from regularity to chaos in classical dynamics is visualized through Poincaré sections.

arxiv-2409-16894.title: Wrapped in Anansi’s Web: Unweaving the Impacts of Generative-AI Personalization and VR Immersion in Oral Storytelling CCS: Human-centered computing User studies CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in interaction design CCS: Applied computing Interactive learning environments CCS: Applied
arxiv-2409-16894.creator: Ka Hei Carrie Lau, Bhada Yun, Samuel Saruba, Efe Bozkir, Enkelejda Kasneci
arxiv-2409-16894.description: Abstract . Oral traditions, vital to cultural identity, are losing relevance among youth due to the dominance of modern media. This study addresses the revitalization of these traditions by reconnecting young people with folklore. We introduce Anansi the Spider VR , a novel virtual space that combines first-person virtual reality (VR) with generative artificial intelligence (Gen-AI)-driven narrative personalization.

arxiv-2410-16399.title: Local index theory and Z / k ​ Z \mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z} K K -theory
arxiv-2410-16399.creator: Man-Ho Ho
arxiv-2410-16399.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Man-Ho Ho. For any given submersion π : X → B \pi:X\to B with closed, oriented and spin c fibers of even dimension, equipped with a Riemannian and differential spin c structure, we apply the Atiyah–Singer–Gorokhovsky–Lott approach to the local family index theorem without the kernel bundle assumption to construct an analytic index ind k a \ind^{a}_{k} in odd Z / k ​ Z \mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z} K K -theory at the cocycle level.

arxiv-2505-01608.title: On the principal eigenvectors of random Markov matrices
arxiv-2505-01608.creator: Jacob Calvert, Frank den Hollander, Dana Randall
arxiv-2505-01608.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jacob Calvert, Frank den Hollander, Dana Randall. We analyze the invariant distributions of continuous-time and discrete-time random walks on randomly weighted complete digraphs. These distributions correspond to the principal left eigenvectors of the associated random Markov generators and kernels, viewed as random matrices. While much is known about the spectra of these matrices, relatively little is known about the principal left eigenvectors, which are delicate random objects for which no explicit form is known.

arxiv-2508-12586.title: Foundation Model for Skeleton-Based Human Action Understanding
arxiv-2508-12586.creator: Hongsong Wang, Wanjiang Weng, Junbo Wang, Fang Zhao, Guo-Sen Xie, Xin Geng, Senior Member, IEEE, Liang Wang, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2508-12586.description: Abstract Human action understanding serves as a foundational pillar in the field of intelligent motion perception. Skeletons serve as a modality- and device-agnostic representation for human modeling, and skeleton-based action understanding has potential applications in humanoid robot control and interaction. However, existing works often lack the scalability and generalization required to handle diverse action understanding tasks.

A 7 7 -tuple of commuting bounded operators T = ( T 1 , … , T 7 ) \textbf{T}=(T_{1},\dots,T_{7}) on a Hilbert space ℋ \mathcal{H} is called a Γ E ⁡ ( 3 , 3 , 1 , 1 , 1 ) \Gamma_{E(3;3;1,1,1)} -contraction if Γ E ⁡ ( 3 , 3 , 1 , 1 , 1 ) \Gamma_{E(3;3;1,1,1)} is a spectral set for T .

pmc-10672323.title: Candida albicans Biofilm-Derived Extracellular Vesicles Are Involved in the Tolerance to Caspofungin, Biofilm Detachment, and Fungal Proteolytic Activity
pmc-10672323.creator: Justyna Karkowska-Kuleta, Kamila Kulig, Grazyna Bras, Karolina Stelmaszczyk, Magdalena Surowiec, Andrzej Kozik, Elzbieta Karnas, Olga Barczyk-Woznicka, Ewa Zuba-Surma, Elzbieta Pyza, Maria Rapala-Kozik
pmc-10672323.description: It has been repeatedly reported that the cells of organisms in all kingdoms of life produce nanometer-sized lipid membrane-enveloped extracellular vesicles (EVs), transporting and protecting various substances of cellular origin. While the composition of EVs produced by human pathogenic fungi has been studied in recent decades, another important challenge is the analysis of their functionality.

pmc-11301420.title: miR-181d-5p ameliorates hypercholesterolemia by targeting PCSK9
pmc-11301420.creator: Yu Wang, Fan Li, Xiaoqian Gao, Huahui Yu, Zhiyong Du, Linyi Li, Yunhui Du, Chaowei Hu, Yanwen Qin
pmc-11301420.description: Hypercholesterolemia is an independent risk factor for cardiovascular disease and lowering circulating levels of low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) can prevent and reduce cardiovascular events. MicroRNA-181d (miR-181d) can reduce the levels of triglycerides and cholesterol esters in cells. However, it is not known whether miR-181d-5p can lower levels of circulating LDL-C.

pmc-12171967.title: Evaluation of medical ethics education using the CIPP model: a study on the perspectives of medical students
pmc-12171967.creator: Amirhossein Alirezaie, Habibeh Ahmadipour, Mina Mobasher
pmc-12171967.description: Many medical schools are adopting varied teaching strategies to enhance students' understanding of the humanitarian aspects of their specialties. This study evaluated medical ethics education at Kerman University of Medical Sciences (Iran) from the students’ perspectives using the CIPP modelA cross-sectional study involving 136 clerkship medical students used convenience sampling and a validated, researcher-made questionnaire based on the CIPP model.

pmc-12735796.title: Comparative Study on Extracts from Traditional Medicinal Plants Echinacea purpurea (L.) Moench and Onopordum acanthium (L.): Antioxidant Activity In Vitro and Anxiolytic Effect In Vivo
pmc-12735796.creator: Maria Vlasheva, Mariana Katsarova, Ilin Kandilarov, Hristina Zlatanova-Tenisheva, Petya Gardjeva, Petko Denev, Kiril Atliev, Nora Sadakova, Maria Dimitrova, Ilia Kostadinov, Stela Dimitrova, Mozaniel Santana de Oliveira, Cristiane S F Maia, Enéas A Fontes-Júnior, Jofre J S Freitas
pmc-12735796.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Echinacea purpurea (L.) Moench (EP) and Onopordum acanthium (L.) (OA) are promising medicinal plants with diverse biological activities but there is no information on the effects of their combinations. To harness the therapeutic potential of both while minimizing the risk of adverse effects, we prepared two combinations (CE1 and CE2) of EP and OA in ratios 1:1 and 3:1, respectively.

pmc-13126539.title: Epidemiology of vaso-occlusive crisis among sickle cell disease patients in India: A community-based multi-centric study
pmc-13126539.creator: Shaily B. Surti, Shubhangi Patel, Yogita Sharma, Deepa Bhat, Parikipandla Sridevi, Jatin Sarmah, Madhusmita Bal, Manoranjan Ranjit, Rabindra Kumar Jena, Bontha V. Babu
pmc-13126539.description: Background and objectivesMorbidity burden of sickle cell disease (SCD) in India has been underestimated till now due to a lack of nationwide data on the prevalence of clinical outcomes, including the most prevalent clinical manifestations like vaso-occlusive crises (VOCs). This multi-centric study reports the epidemiological characteristics of VOCs among SCD patients in India.

pmc-13205403.title: Racial and Geographic Disparities in Automated External Defibrillator Use During EMS Encounters in the United States
pmc-13205403.creator: Peter G. Kreysa
pmc-13205403.description: Highlights What are the main findings? AED use during EMS encounters shows clear racial and geographic inequities, with White patients and suburban/rural/frontier regions experiencing the lowest deployment rates.Disparities persist even within clinically severe encounters such as cardiac arrest and high-acuity cases, indicating that clinical need alone does not explain variation in AED use.

pmc-13624338.title: Organisational ethical climate and nurses’ work performance: A cross-sectional analysis of the indirect association through job crafting
pmc-13624338.creator: Mehmet Gülşen, Nurşah Tatoğlu, Ayşe Karadaş
pmc-13624338.description: BackgroundOrganisational ethical climate is relevant to nursing practice and employee outcomes, but its association with nurses’ work performance has received limited attention, particularly in relation to job crafting.ObjectiveTo examine the associations between organisational ethical climate, job crafting, and work performance among nurses in Türkiye, and to assess whether job crafting statistically mediated the association between ethical climate and work performance.
